name: elite-chocolate-automation
description: ELITE CHOCOLATE POS & Bills — run API + UI together

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
